FROM 
D360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE WHERE H = 'D'

scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
SELECT 
				 [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE_SELECT_SRC
(
				 [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
				 CC.[BACID]
				,CC.[BANK_ID]
				,CC.[DEL_FLG]
				,CC.[BACID_DESC]
				,CC.[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,CC.[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,CC.[LCHG_TIME]
				,CC.[RCRE_TIME]
				,CC.[SCHM_TYPE]
				,CC.[TS_CNT]
				,CC.[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,CC.[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,CC.[FILE_NAME]
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE CC
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE_GROUP_SRC
(
				 [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT 
				,FILE_DATE
)

select 
				 [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY     [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.BACID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BACID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BANK_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1



INSERT INTO EDS.GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE
(
				 [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,SCD_START_DATE 
				,SCD_END_DATE
				,ISACTIVE
				,ISLATEST
				,BNK_CODE
				,SOURCE_CODE 
				,FILE_NAME 
				,insert_dttm
)
SELECT
				 [BACID]
				,[BANK_ID]
				,[DEL_FLG]
				,[BACID_DESC]
				,[LCHG_USER_ID]
				,[RCRE_USER_ID]
				,[LCHG_TIME]
				,[RCRE_TIME]
				,[SCHM_TYPE]
				,[TS_CNT]
				,[PLACEHOLDER_TYPE]
				,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
				,@DATETOPROCESS
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5)
				,'GLD'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_GLD_ACCTPLACEHOLDERTABLE_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
